description: Install an SQLite viewer extension and use it to extract data from test_data.sqlite. Open the Extensions view (Ctrl+Shift+X) or Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P), search for 'SQLite' viewer extensions (such as 'SQLite' by alexcvzz, 'SQLite Viewer' by qwtel, or 'SQLTools' by mtxr), and install one. After installation, open the file 'test_data.sqlite' in the workspace. View the 'users' table in the database and find: (1) alice@example.com's user_id, (2) bob@example.com's user_id, and (3) the total number of users in the table. Then open 'investigation_notes.txt' in the workspace and replace the [FILL IN] placeholders with the actual values you found. Save the notes file when done. The database has a 'users' table with columns: user_id, email, name, created_at.
